routine_id.meaning: Routine identifier. If the routine_id key is present it takes precedence over unit even when not a string; unit is the legacy alias. An empty or non-string selected value is refused by hold and release.

unit.meaning: Legacy alias for routine_id, used only when routine_id is absent; it is not the systemd unit stop.

routine_id.meaning: Routine identifier used by the operation.

held.meaning: True for hold when the routine is registered; release reports false.

changed.meaning: Whether the hold or program rows changed.

acquired.meaning: True when a registered routine was not already held before the hold request.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: pid2-invalid-json: <parser message>, protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index>, protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field>, pid2-lock-directory: <OS error>, pid2-lock-open: <OS error>, pid2-walk-lock: <OS error>, pid2-action-lock: <OS error>, pid2-command-wake-persist-failed: <detail>, <raw SQLite or stored-envelope parser error text>. On success the final receipt reports none.
